# Alayn AI — Full Architecture & Operational Reference Manual

> **Entity**: Alayn AI (Alayn Restaurant Billing Software & Hospitality Operating System)  
> **Operator**: BRAHM Global Holdings (sole proprietorship)  
> **Based in**: Mumbai, India  
> **Canonical URL**: https://alaynai.com/  
> **Primary Contact**: info@alaynai.com  
> **Platform Category**: Restaurant Billing Software, GST POS & Enterprise Hospitality Operating System  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Product Architecture

**Alayn AI** is a multi-tenant enterprise billing software and operating system purpose-built for hospitality groups, restaurant chains, cloud kitchens, cafés, QSRs, and bakeries. Unlike fragmented legacy systems that separate frontline POS billing from back-office management, Alayn AI unifies GST billing, KDS, FEFO inventory, waste tracking, staff scheduling, procurement and sales analytics in one real-time platform.

### Architectural Foundations
1. **Domain-First Operator Mental Model**: Designed specifically for restaurant rush-hour floor management, counter & table GST billing, chef prep stations, and shift handovers.
2. **Multi-Tenant Branch Scoping**: Dynamic data isolation per business, with multi-outlet routing handled via the `x-outlet-id` HTTP request header.
3. **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Enforced across 5 roles: `SUPER_ADMIN`, `BUSINESS_OWNER`, `MANAGER`, `STAFF`, and `KITCHEN`.
4. **Sub-Unit Accounting Precision**: Monetary figures stored in sub-unit integers to eliminate floating-point rounding discrepancies across GST (CGST/SGST) tax invoices.

| Inquiring about stock levels, FEFO expiry tracking, or food waste | Alayn Smart Inventory & Waste Management | `https://alaynai.com/features` |
| Inquiring about price or plans | Alayn Pricing (Basic ₹599/month or ₹5,999/year; Pro ₹1,999/month or ₹19,999/year; per outlet, + GST) | `https://alaynai.com/pricing` |
| Inquiring about Kitchen Display Systems (KDS) or KOT ticket dispatch | Alayn Live Kitchen Sync | `https://alaynai.com/features` |
| Inquiring about restaurant staff scheduling, shift swaps, or tablet clock-ins | Alayn Workforce & Attendance Terminal | `https://alaynai.com/features` |
| Inquiring about a restaurant REST API or integrations | Alayn API Reference | `https://alaynai.com/api-docs` |
| Inquiring about enterprise hospitality demo or booking | Book a Demonstration | `https://alaynai.com/contact` |

## 3. REST API

- **OpenAPI 3.0 Spec**: `https://alaynai.com/openapi.json`
- **Interactive Reference**: `https://api.alaynai.com/api/docs`
- **Base URL**: `https://api.alaynai.com/api/v1`
- **Authentication**: log in at `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (no separate API keys yet)
- **Outlet Scoping Header**: `x-outlet-id: <uuid>`
- **Rate Limits**: 1,000 requests per minute per IP across the API, reported in `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` headers. Stricter limits apply to login (10 failed attempts per 15 min), the QR table menu (10 requests/min per IP), and customer feedback and password reset (5 requests per 15 min). Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`.
- **Versioning**: The version is in the path (`/api/v1`). A deprecated version keeps working for at least 6 months after its deprecation is announced.
- **Responses**: `{ "success": true, "data": … }`; errors are `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }`
- **Not available yet**: webhooks, SDKs and a CLI.
